content: {DRAFT} Service Name EthIf_SwitchMacSecResetRxSc (DRAFT) Syntax Std_ReturnType EthIf_SwitchMacSecResetRxSc ( const EthSwt_MgmtInfoType * MgmtInfoPtr, uint64 Sci ) Service ID [hex] 0x6f 5 112 of 192 Document ID 417: AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetInterface Specification of Ethernet Interface AUTOSAR CP R22-11 4 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different MgmtInfoPtr, Non reentrant for the same MgmtInfoPtr MgmtInfoPtr Pointer to the management information within the context of an Ethernet Switch Driver. SwitchIdx in context of EthIf, PortIdx in context of EthSwt. Parameters (in) Sci Secure Channel Identifier for the MACsec's Reception Secure channel Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted Description Requests the Ethernet Switch Driver to reset to default the MACsec values of the Reception Secure Channel for the given Secure Channel Identifier.
